page: Microsoft Azure L128as_v5 is a high-capacity storage and memory-optimized server instance belonging to the Lasv5 family. Powered by an x86_64 AMD processor, this virtual machine runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 128 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware configuration includes 1024.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

A defining characteristic of the L128as_v5 is its massive local storage capacity, which consists of 30,718 GB of NVMe SSD storage. This local storage is complemented by Premium Storage capability for external disk attachments. The instance does not include any integrated graphics processing units and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of both local NVMe storage and system memory, this instance offers a specialized hardware profile designed for data-intensive operations. The lack of GPU acceleration makes it less suitable for deep learning or graphics rendering, but the combination of 128 dedicated vCPUs, a 1:8 memory-to-vCPU ratio, and over 30 TB of local NVMe SSD storage makes it highly efficient for large-scale databases, big data analytics, and transactional workloads that require low-latency local storage.
